title: Total influence of unate functions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be unate, meaning that in each coordinate it is either nondecreasing or nonincreasing when that coordinate changes from $-1$ to $1$. Then the total influence of $f$ is at most the total influence of majority on $n$ signs.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ signs
